scope: AI Factory hackathon Phase 1 only: five existing public assets

receipt_model.entity_rule: One advisor forecast is one EAS attestation and one UID
receipt_model.transport_rule: One native EAS multiAttest transaction per selected asset carries all validated advisor attestations for that asset
receipt_model.gas_estimate_method: For planning only: each final 17-field Pepsi payload size is extrapolated through a linear fit to two observed Base EAS direct attestations. The sum deliberately excludes multiAttest savings and the exact serialized L1 fee.
receipt_model.operational_benefit: Reduces 12 signatures, broadcasts and confirmations to one per asset while preserving 12 independent UIDs. Exact gas saving must be measured with eth_estimateGas on the encoded call.

phase_1.selection_rule: All five named assets are already public; no random selection is used in Phase 1.

phase_1_fee_gate.rule: Use the five exact serialized multiAttest transactions. Sum buffered eth_estimateGas execution costs plus GasPriceOracle.getL1Fee and convert at a buffered ETH/USD rate. If all five exceed 4.25 USD, wait for a cheaper window; do not omit an asset based on its forecast.

selection_policy.fixed_core: Exactly the five existing public showcase assets in Phase 1
selection_policy.random_rotation: Out of scope for the hackathon
selection_policy.publication_rule: Use Batch 6 as the labeled retrospective pilot, then issue future selected public batches after the public-live gate
selection_policy.asset_atomicity: If an asset is selected, attest every validated individual advisor forecast; never select advisors or assets based on current forecast direction or performance

transaction_policy.default: Twelve independent forecast attestations in one asset-level EAS multiAttest transaction
transaction_policy.fallback: If eth_estimateGas plus a 20 percent gas-limit buffer exceeds Base's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap, split that asset deterministically into two calls, normally 6 plus 6
transaction_policy.never: Never combine multiple assets into one transaction and never represent 12 forecasts by one batch hash
